editorial:
Imagine you are a young cop in Italy trying to catch a scary killer who targets women. You start off confident, but as you dig deeper into the case, the killer starts playing games with your head. The whole movie feels like a bad dream where the lines between your job and your personal life start to blur. You will feel the tension build up as the hunter becomes the hunted, and the bright, sunny streets of Italy suddenly feel very dangerous. It is a wild ride that focuses on how a person can lose their grip on reality when they are pushed too far.

The acting is solid, and the way the camera moves makes you feel like you are right there in the action. While the plot gets a bit confusing toward the end, the shock value and the gore keep things interesting. If you like movies that make you feel uneasy, you should definitely give this one a shot.
endingExplained: You find out that the killer has been manipulating the main character the entire time. In the final scenes, the truth comes out about his identity and his obsession with her. After a brutal fight and a lot of chaos, the killer is finally stopped. However, the movie leaves you feeling unsettled because the trauma the main character went through has changed her forever, showing that some scars never truly heal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy mysteries and old-school slashers.
